SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.hla_a_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_A_Val')::real) AS a_locus_mismatches,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.hla_b_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_B_Val')::real) AS b_locus_mismatches,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.hla_dr_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_Dr_Val')::real) AS dr_locus_mismatches
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
JOIN hla_info h ON h.immu_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed' AND cm.hla_mis_count = 1
note: Data never shows a single-locus difference; counted per-locus donor/recipient inequality among completed matches with hla_mis_count=1.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT tm.match_rec_registry, ar.tx_cen_code AS center_id,
         (re.riskmetrics->>'Infect_Risk')::numeric AS infection_risk,
         (mh.viralstatinfo->>'Cmv_State' = 'Positive' AND ri.cmv_state = 'Negative') AS cmv_mismatch
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON ar.adm_rev_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN risk_evaluation re ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN medical_history mh ON mh.contrib_med_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status IN ('Completed', 'In Progress')
)
SELECT b.match_rec_registry, b.center_id, b.infection_risk,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.infection_risk), 4) FROM base o WHERE o.center_id = b.center_id AND NOT o.cmv_mismatch) AS avg_center_non_mismatch_infection_risk
FROM base b
WHERE b.cmv_mismatch
ORDER BY b.center_id

WITH p AS (
  SELECT tm.recip_ref_reg, tm.org_spec, ri.life_support,
    0.7 * CASE WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5 WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
               WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 2','2') THEN 3 WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 3','3') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
    + 0.3 * (substring(c.wait_time FROM '^[0-9.]+')::numeric / 365.0) AS urgency
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Pending'
)
SELECT p.recip_ref_reg AS recipient_registry_id, p.life_support, ROUND(p.urgency, 4) AS urgency_score,
  ROUND((SELECT AVG(o.urgency) FROM p o WHERE o.org_spec = p.org_spec AND o.life_support IS NULL), 4) AS avg_non_life_support_urgency
FROM p
WHERE p.life_support IN ('ECMO', 'VAD')
ORDER BY p.org_spec, p.urgency

WITH base AS (
  SELECT tm.dss_val,
         1.0 / (1.0 + EXP(-(-0.5
            + 1.5 * (0.6 * CASE WHEN LOWER(cm.blood_compat) = 'compatible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                     + 0.4 * (1 - cm.hla_mis_count / 6.0))
            - 0.02 * substring(d.age_count FROM '^\d+')::numeric))) AS egs
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN demographics d ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed' AND tm.dss_val IS NOT NULL
), b AS (
  SELECT base.*, LEAST(WIDTH_BUCKET(dss_val, mn, mx, 5), 5) AS dss_bucket
  FROM base CROSS JOIN (SELECT MIN(dss_val) mn, MAX(dss_val) mx FROM base) s
)
SELECT dss_bucket, COUNT(*) AS transplant_count, ROUND(AVG(egs), 4) AS avg_egs_score
FROM b GROUP BY dss_bucket ORDER BY dss_bucket

WITH base AS (
  SELECT l.trans_method,
         substring(cm.exp_isch_time FROM '^[0-9.]+')::numeric + substring(cm.exp_time FROM '^[0-9.]+')::numeric AS total_ischemia_min,
         substring(cm.distance FROM '^[0-9.]+')::numeric * 1.60934 AS distance_km
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN logistics l ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
), r AS (
  SELECT trans_method, total_ischemia_min / distance_km AS ratio FROM base WHERE distance_km >= 10
)
SELECT trans_method, ROUND(AVG(ratio), 4) AS avg_efficiency_ratio, ROUND(MIN(ratio), 4) AS min_efficiency_ratio, ROUND(MAX(ratio), 4) AS max_efficiency_ratio
FROM r GROUP BY trans_method ORDER BY AVG(ratio)

SELECT ri.immu_recip_registry AS recipient_registry_id, ri.pra_score, ri.dsa_state,
  CASE WHEN ri.pra_score >= 80 AND ri.dsa_state = 'Positive' THEN 'High Risk' ELSE 'Standard Risk' END AS amr_risk_category,
  (SELECT MAX(tm.created_ts::timestamp) FROM transplant_matching tm WHERE tm.recip_ref_reg = ri.immu_recip_registry) AS last_match_attempt_ts
FROM recipients_immunology ri
WHERE ri.cross_result = 'Positive'
ORDER BY ri.pra_score DESC NULLS LAST

WITH p AS (
  SELECT tm.recip_ref_reg, ad.allc_region, c.med_urgency, cm.hla_mis_count,
    CASE WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5 WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
         WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 2','2') THEN 3 WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 3','3') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS urgency_val
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN allocation_details ad ON ad.allc_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Pending' AND tm.org_spec = 'Pancreas'
)
SELECT recip_ref_reg AS recipient_registry_id, allc_region, med_urgency, hla_mis_count,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY allc_region ORDER BY urgency_val DESC, hla_mis_count ASC) AS region_rank
FROM p
ORDER BY allc_region, region_rank
note: med_urgency has bare "2"/"3" values; treated as Status 2/Status 3. RANK used for ties.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT tm.match_rec_registry, tm.donor_ref_reg, tm.recip_ref_reg,
    substring(cm.cost_est FROM '[0-9.]+')::numeric / (5 * re.qol_val::numeric) AS cer
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN risk_evaluation re ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed' AND tm.org_spec = 'Lung' AND re.qol_val > 0
), t AS (
  SELECT base.*, NTILE(20) OVER (ORDER BY cer) AS bucket FROM base
)
SELECT match_rec_registry, donor_ref_reg, recip_ref_reg, ROUND(cer, 2) AS cer
FROM t WHERE bucket IN (1, 20)
ORDER BY cer

WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT d.physicalstats->>'Ethnicity' AS donor_ethnicity, r.ethn_grp AS recipient_ethnicity,
         substring(d.blood_class FROM '^(AB|A|B|O)') AS dabo,
         substring(r.blood_class FROM '^(AB|A|B|O)') AS rabo,
         cm.hla_mis_count,
         1 - ABS((d.physicalstats->>'Bmi_Value')::numeric / r.bmi_val::numeric - 1) AS size_score
  FROM compatibility_metrics cm
  JOIN demographics d ON d.contrib_registry = cm.donor_ref_reg
  JOIN recipients_demographics r ON r.recip_registry = cm.recip_ref_reg
), optimal AS (
  SELECT * FROM pairs
  WHERE (dabo = 'O' OR rabo = 'AB' OR dabo = rabo)
    AND hla_mis_count = 0
    AND size_score BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.1
)
SELECT donor_ethnicity,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'African') AS "African",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Asian') AS "Asian",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Caucasian') AS "Caucasian",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Hispanic') AS "Hispanic",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Other') AS "Other"
FROM optimal
GROUP BY donor_ethnicity
ORDER BY donor_ethnicity

WITH base AS (
  SELECT l.trans_method,
    substring(cm.exp_isch_time FROM '^[0-9.]+')::numeric + substring(cm.exp_time FROM '^[0-9.]+')::numeric AS total_ischemia_min,
    1.0 / (1.0 + EXP(-(-0.5
       + 1.5 * (0.6 * CASE WHEN LOWER(cm.blood_compat) = 'compatible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + 0.4 * (1 - cm.hla_mis_count / 6.0))
       - 0.02 * substring(d.age_count FROM '^\d+')::numeric))) AS egs
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN logistics l ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN demographics d ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
)
SELECT trans_method, ROUND(AVG(total_ischemia_min), 2) AS avg_total_ischemia_min, ROUND(AVG(egs), 4) AS avg_egs_score
FROM base GROUP BY trans_method ORDER BY avg_egs_score DESC
